trust_boundaries: dmz-to-internal: api_gateway to auth_service and app_server
internal: auth_service to redis (no encryption on loopback)
architecture_summary.operational_context: Cloud REST API with token-based authentication and session caching

threat_actors.name: API Abuser
threat_actors.motivation: Extract user data or impersonate other users for financial fraud
threat_actors.initial_access_vector: Public API endpoint enumeration using automated tools
non_capabilities: No access to internal network — must reach services through API gateway only
No knowledge of token signing secrets

threat_actors.name: Targeted Credential Attacker
threat_actors.motivation: Account takeover of high-value users for data or pivot
threat_actors.initial_access_vector: Phishing or credential database from prior breach
non_capabilities: No direct Redis or App Server network access
No ability to intercept TLS without CA compromise
No insider access to auth_service configuration

attack_paths.impact: Valid JWT acquisition for any user lacking rate limiting
attack_paths.likelihood_rationale: No rate limiting at gateway layer confirmed; auth endpoints are high-value brute-force targets

attack_paths.entry_point: Bearer token in Authorization header from AP-001 or credential stuffing
attack_paths.impact: Authenticated access to all resources owned by compromised account
attack_paths.likelihood_rationale: Credential stuffing success rates consistently 1-5% against poorly protected endpoints

attack_paths.entry_point: Internal network between auth_service and redis (unencrypted)
attack_paths.impact: Session token harvest for active sessions — no decryption required
attack_paths.likelihood_rationale: Requires prior internal network foothold; opportunistic attacker unlikely to reach this layer

attack_paths.entry_point: Forged or replayed JWT token if signing secret is weak
attack_paths.impact: Privilege escalation to admin role if JWT lacks role binding or expiry enforcement
attack_paths.likelihood_rationale: JWT misconfiguration (none alg, weak secret) is common; depends on implementation quality

mitigations.control_name: Authentication rate limiting and account lockout
Encrypt data in transit — TLS on Redis
JWT strong signing with RS256 and expiry enforcement

findings.severity_rationale: No brute-force protection on auth endpoint; automated tools can achieve token acquisition in minutes
Credential stuffing is viable without MFA; account takeover probability scales with prior breach data availability
Redis sniffing requires prior internal access; exposure is real but constrained by network position requirement
JWT none algorithm or weak HMAC misconfiguration is a known class of issue; partial implementation suggests incomplete hardening
